fee_policy: fee = 2.90% of a positive gross_amount + 0.30, rounded HALF_UP to 2 decimals
settlement_window_rule: bank settlement expected within 3 calendar days after the latest processor event in a settlement batch
currency_rule: no FX conversion; a currency difference between sides is an exception

match_levels.SETTLEMENT: processor_transactions (grouped by settlement_batch_id, net) <-> bank_settlements on settlement_batch_id

failure_recovery_restart_contract: optional batch-job test: persist chunks of 500 rows, fail in a controlled way after 2,500 processed rows (5 committed chunks), restart from the last committed chunk without duplicate results
duplicate_file_test: mixed-exceptions/internal_transactions_duplicate.csv is a byte-identical copy of internal_transactions.csv; a robust importer should detect it
